title: Medical Expert Knowledge Meets AI to Enhance Symptom Checker Performance for Rare Disease Identification in Fabry Disease: Mixed Methods Study.
summary: In a prospective pilot, expert-derived Fabry disease vignettes were added to an AI symptom checker and compared with its original version in six patients. The optimized version suggested Fabry disease first in 2/6 cases versus 1/6 with the original version and received higher user-satisfaction ratings.
ai_technology: AI symptom checker augmented with five clinical vignettes derived from interviews with three Fabry disease experts.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed
